CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.base_config()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT private.org_role_previous_config()||jsonb_build_object('position_slots',c->'position_slots','role_links',c->'role_links','memberships',c->'memberships','units',c->'units','titles',c->'titles') FROM (SELECT private.org_config() c OFFSET 0) snapshot $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.base_effective(u uuid, c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE result jsonb:='[]';r record;d text;l jsonb;ok boolean;privileged boolean;active boolean;rules jsonb;BEGIN active:=private.is_active(u);privileged:=private.is_super_admin(u);rules:=private.base_rules(u,c);FOR r IN SELECT * FROM base_permission_catalog ORDER BY module,key LOOP d:=CASE WHEN private.base_supported(r.key) THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(rules) x WHERE x->>'permission'=r.key AND x->>'effect'='DENY') THEN 'DENY' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(rules) x WHERE x->>'permission'=r.key AND x->>'effect'='ALLOW') THEN 'ALLOW' ELSE 'NOT_CONFIGURED' END ELSE 'NOT_CONFIGURED' END;l:=private.base_legacy(u,r.key);ok:=active AND (privileged OR (r.key LIKE 'biz.crm_%' AND public.biz_admin(u)) OR CASE WHEN d='DENY' THEN false WHEN d='ALLOW' THEN true ELSE (l->>'allowed')::boolean END);result:=result||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key',r.key,'label',r.label,'module',r.module,'allowed',ok,'decision',d,'bypass',privileged OR (r.key LIKE 'biz.crm_%' AND public.biz_admin(u)),'tier',CASE WHEN privileged OR (r.key LIKE 'biz.crm_%' AND public.biz_admin(u)) THEN 0 WHEN d<>'NOT_CONFIGURED' THEN 1 ELSE (l->'source'->>'tier')::int END,'legacy',l,'sources',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM jsonb_array_elements(rules) x WHERE x->>'permission'=r.key),'[]'::jsonb),'supported',private.base_supported(r.key),'scope',CASE WHEN r.key LIKE 'biz.crm_%' AND d='ALLOW' THEN 'own' ELSE 'native' END,'conflict',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(rules) x WHERE x->>'permission'=r.key AND x->>'effect'='ALLOW') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(rules) x WHERE x->>'permission'=r.key AND x->>'effect'='DENY')));END LOOP;RETURN result;END $function$
name: private.base_effective
private.base_legacy

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.base_permissions_effective(_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE u uuid:=coalesce(_user,auth.uid());BEGIN IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT private.is_active(auth.uid()) OR (u<>auth.uid() AND NOT private.base_org_admin()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Không có quyền xem phân quyền.';END IF;RETURN jsonb_build_object('user_id',u,'revision',coalesce((SELECT revision FROM base_org_state WHERE id),0),'server_now',now(),'next_transition_at',private.base_next_transition(private.base_config()),'permissions',private.base_effective(u,private.base_config()));END $function$
name: public.base_permissions_effective

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.org_can(u uuid, p text, target_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE rules jsonb;BEGIN IF u IS NULL OR NOT private.is_active(u) THEN RETURN false;END IF; IF private.is_super_admin(u) THEN RETURN true; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM org_units WHERE id=target_id AND active) THEN RETURN false; END IF; rules:=private.base_rules(u,private.org_config()); RETURN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(rules) r WHERE r->>'permission'=p AND r->>'effect'='DENY' AND (nullif(r->>'unit_id','') IS NULL OR private.org_contains(r->>'unit_id',target_id))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(rules) r WHERE r->>'permission'=p AND r->>'effect'='ALLOW' AND (nullif(r->>'unit_id','') IS NULL OR private.org_contains(r->>'unit_id',target_id))); END $function$
args: u uuid, p text, target_id text
name: private.org_can

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql

 SET search_path TO 'public'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.org_contains(root_id text, target_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT id,ARRAY[id] path FROM org_units WHERE id=root_id AND active UNION ALL SELECT u.id,t.path||u.id FROM org_units u JOIN tree t ON u.parent_id=t.id WHERE u.active AND NOT u.id=ANY(t.path)) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tree WHERE id=target_id) $function$
name: private.org_contains
